verdict.rationale: Unleash supports genuine background automation for feature releases: scheduled releases at a specific date/time, and impact-metrics-driven automation that progresses rollouts or pauses/disables environments automatically when thresholds are crossed — both running autonomously without manual intervention. However, this is scoped narrowly to flag-rollout automation rather than general-purpose agentic task automation, and there's no evidence of broader autonomous background workflows beyond release management. missing for 10: evidence of general-purpose autonomous automation beyond rollout/release scheduling, evidence of AI-agent-triggered automations (the MCP server is for flag creation, not autonomous background execution), independent corroboration of the impact-metrics automation working reliably in production.
